notes.title: Mutants: Genesis is officially out on PC and mobile!
notes.content:
🎉 Mutants: Genesis is officially out on PC and mobile!

It's a moment we've been waiting for: Mutants: Genesis is officially out today on Steam and also on mobile! After more than two years of early access, community feedback, tweaks, new features and content, the time has come to take the plunge.

But first of all: thank you. 🙏

Thank you to everyone who joined us early, who battled bugs, shared feedback, tested absurd combos, and helped us evolve the game. You've been the pillars of this adventure, and we'd like to look back with you on everything we've achieved together.

📅 2 years of continuous evolution: how far we've come

Since its early access launch, Mutants: Genesis has changed a lot. Here are some of the key moments that have marked this first year:

🧬 Hundreds of cards and a first-ever drop: the Pioneer Drop

Our first massive content addition! With new cards and new mechanics, the Pioneer Drop has redefined deckbuilding possibilities and paved the way for new strategies.

➡️ Read the article on Pioneer Drop 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/3653033508006275181

💥 More intense combat with Extreme Mode

Thought you'd seen it all in PvE? Extreme Mode has raised the bar. New bosses, more ferocious, more demanding, more... nasty. It's simple: if you've survived this, you're ready for anything.

➡️ Read the Extreme Mode article
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/3653036678838019803

⏳ Time Rifts: cooperative PvE for up to 3 players

A game mode designed for those who like to play together. Every week, there are new Time Rifts to explore, with cooperative challenges for 2 or 3 players, exclusive rewards, and epic clashes against mutated Bosses!

➡️ Read the article on Time Rifts
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/3801661817161331029

🎂 Our first anniversary and a loyal community!

One year already! We've been celebrating with special events and rewards, but most of all with you, the community. Some have been with us since the first versions, others joined us later - but all have contributed to the growth of Mutants: Genesis.

➡️ Read the anniversary article
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/4179980031218599334

🧠 Ascension: a new story act and the arrival of Arc 2

The story continues with Ascension, our major narrative update. New ardsc, new mechanics, new challenges. The universe of Mutants: Genesis is growing and expanding, and this is just the beginning.

➡️ Read the Ascension article
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/4226147001142488719


📱 20 May: a PC and mobile release

The big news in version 1.0 is the availability of Mutants: Genesis on mobile!
Play wherever you want, whenever you want, in the same conditions as on PC, with full crossplay and synchronised progression.

💬 This is just the beginning

We're a small, independent team, and every piece of feedback, every message, every bug report has a direct impact on the game. The launch, for us, isn't an end - it's the start of a new chapter.

Now that Mutants: Genesis is in your hands on PC and mobile, we can't wait to see what you create, imagine, break, and dominate.

Thank you again for your support. Thank you for your patience. Thank you for your passion.
And most of all... to your decks, Psycogs. 🧬

—
The Celsius Online team

—

notes.title: Balance Patch - V 0.7.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balancing patchnote!

Objectifs

This balance patch follows the release of several new maps linked to Chapter 2, and a stabilisation of the meta after the various releases. It was therefore necessary for us to take stock of the state of the game and propose relevant changes to the various maps, particularly those linked to Chapter 2. 

___________________________________________________________________

New Mechanic: Exhaustion

Based on our analysis and the many feedbacks we received from the community during early access, we noticed that Support cards with draw effects were too prevalent compared to what we had initially planned. This led to a style of play that relied heavily on the use of multiple Support cards over short periods to draw large volumes of cards. In order to bring the draw down to an acceptable level without applying a direct and violent penalty on the individual potential of the draw effects, we chose to introduce a new game mechanic called Exhaustion. 

Exhaustion is an individual global counter, reset to zero at the end of your turn, and used to limit the power of certain cards and effects. Initially, only Support cards will interact with this mechanic. 

Some Support cards now have the keyword Exhaustion. This keyword indicates 2 things: 

Firstly, when you play this card, at the end of the resolution of its effects, your Exhaustion counter increases by 1. 

Secondly, the power of the card's effects will be reduced according to the Exhaustion value. 

For example: all 6 Genetic Cycling cards will be affected by this keyword. During a turn, you start your turn with 0 Depletion. You play your first Genetic Cycling and draw 2 cards. If you play a second Genetic Cycling during the same turn, you will draw one less card due to Exhaustion. 

[Cards affected by Depletion


 Genetic Cycling - Tech


Discard a Tech mutant or Gadget card: draw 2 cards.


 Genetic Cycling - Blades


Discard a Blades mutant: draw 2 cards.


 Genetic Cycling - Zoo


Discard a Zoo mutant: draw 2cards.


 Genetic Cycling - Necro


Discard a Necro mutant: draw 2 cards.


 Genetic Cycling - Space


Discard a Space mutant: draw 2 cards.


 Genetic Cycling - Mystic


Discard a Mystic mutant: draw 2 cards.


 Bio-Recycling


Sacrifice one of your uninvoked mutants: draw 2 cards.


 Astragalomancy


Remove 2 Bone cards from your Discard Pile: Draw 2 cards


 Battle Plan


If you have at least 2 mutants with an activated Tactic on your field, draw 2 cards.


 Stylish Unity


If you control at least 2 uninvoked monogen mutants, draw 2 cards.


 IEM Bomb


Discard 1 card. Inflict 1 damage then stasis 2 to all entities on your field and the opponent's field.

___________________________________________________________________

Downward balancing (Nerfs)


 Capacoburger


Although one of the aims of Chapter 2 was to shift the gameplay somewhat towards monogen mutants, some of the cards supporting monogen archetypes proved even more effective than expected in the hands of the community, to the point of becoming deleterious to the game. Capacoburger in particular has opened the door to combinations based on sacrifice attacks to make huge holes in the opponent's defence, bringing the ability for a mutant to inflict 4 extra points of damage during an attack, as well as collateral damage. We're therefore going to reduce the magnitude of the card's effects quite significantly. 

ATK Bonus: +2 → +1

Indigestion: No longer affects buildings. 

___________________________________________________________________

Buffs


 Son of the Storm


The power of this mutant is slightly lower than that of other comparable mutants, due to its limited ability to stay on the field long enough to activate its ability multiple times. We've therefore decided to increase its defensive capacity a little to make it easier for it to resist direct attacks. 

HP increase: 1/2/3/4/6 → 2/3/4/6/9 HP


 Master Oida


This mutant, which has existed since the early days of the game, is still struggling to really find its place as an offensive support mutant. We've therefore decided to increase the power of the attack boost provided by his Action ability, while at the same time reducing his already high defensive potential thanks to his Evasion ability. 

Bonus ATK: +2/3/4/5/7 -> +3/4/5/6/8

HP: 1/3/5/7/10 -> 1/2/4/6/9


 Scarlett


The heroic mutant obtainable only via temporal rifts has proved to be slightly below expectations, due to her stats being a little too low. We are therefore readjusting her attack and HP upwards. 

ATQ: 6 → 7

HP: 6 → 7


 Vital Orb


The two orbs with Reforge do not have the same purpose. One is used to force an equivalent trade in order to recover a Forged Orb, while the other is used to win a battle by surviving it. In order to make the Vital Orb more petinent in its primary role, we have chosen to increase the VP bonus it confers.  

Bonus HP conferred: +1 → +2


 Unloading Crane


The current operation of this building makes it inefficient in its role as a mass gadget generator when several Tech mutants are destroyed. To overcome this problem, we're limiting the frequency of activation, but increasing the quantity of Gadgets generated to make it more stable in its operation.  


 Recycling: 


Before: When one of your Tech Mutants is destroyed, add 1 Gadget to your hand. 

After: Once per turn, when one of your Tech Mutants is destroyed, add 2 Gadgets to your hand.   

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch,

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis

___

notes.title: Balance Patch Summer 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balance patch!

___________________________________________________________________
Balancing down (Nerfs) 📉 
___________________________________________________________________

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/eef604b43bffee34fc0fa51a3805745f3b49a5a5.png

Battle Plan


 Battle Plan allowed Blades-Tactics decks to draw too easily. Generally speaking, we want to limit the use of cards that allow you to draw too much. The Battle Plan function has been slightly modified to allow you to draw a maximum of two cards.


Before: For each mutant with an activated Tactics ability on your field, draw one card (max. 3).

After: If you have at least 2 mutants with an activated Tactics ability on your field, draw 2 cards. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9cd95ab602be181e94cc6fa81d413b25885b8262.png

Planning Table


 Mutants with Tactics benefit too easily from this Building, which gives them power and survivability. In order to limit the impact of this card, we are removing the survivability aspect from its bonus. 


Tactical Advantage Ability:

Before: Passive - All your mutants with Tactics activated have +1 ATQ and +1 HP. 

After: Passive - All your mutants with Tactics activated have +1 ATK. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/0bfa7f6ecbb025da3d3e02c0f40a027602669672.png

Orbital Strike

 The new Heroic Support card is very powerful.We'd like to keep it being play, but reduce its damage slightly.


Before: Discard a card: deals 5 damage to the targeted enemy mutant. 
If the target is a Heroic or Boss mutant, draw a card. 

After: Discard a card: deals 4 damage to the targeted enemy mutant. If the target is a Heroic Mutant or Boss, draw a card. 

___________________________________________________________________

notes.title: The first Major Content Update is coming out!
notes.content:
Greetings Psycogs,

We are super excited to share with you a great news! Our next major content update is right around the corner! Titled: Ascension, it will follow up on where we left off the story during Chapter 1 and introduce new elements of lore, new fights and obviously new cards!

But before going more in depth with its content, let’s check out our Game’s Director letter to the community: 

Dear Psycogs,

On behalf of the entire Mutants: Genesis team, we would like to thank you for your unfailing support since the start of early access, your constant feedback and your constant encouragement.

Being able to talk to you and see how much you like the game, particularly on our community discord, is a very important source of motivation and encouragement for us. This first year of Early Access has been a rich one in many ways: the arrival of Time Rifts, the mobile version (iOS coming soon), the many ranked seasons in which you've fought hard, the Simulacrum (even the Extreme mode couldn't resist the most valiant among you), and above all, even if it's something less visible to you, the major work on stability and bug-fixing on the game, have made this a very beneficial year for the game, which has been able to consolidate its foundations.

Today, to celebrate the start of this second year of Early Access, the team is very proud to finally be releasing the sequel to our campaign, which you seem to be looking forward to just as much as we are: Chapter 2: Ascension.

After passing the Atika trials and being named captain of the Panakeia Junior Team, it's time for you and your two companions to get back into the thick of things. In this new arc, you'll be travelling to the 4 corners of the world to take on the biggest corporations and their champions. Each sub-section corresponds to a corporation represented by one of the game's 6 genes, and the confrontations will lead you to meet some colourful characters, learn about their personal histories, and battle them for the title of Xtrem Junior League of the Year. In this new arc, you'll learn more about the world of Mutants: Genesis, not to mention your rewards: new cards with every victory! 

We hope you enjoy this story arc and that it lives up to your expectations.

As for the sequel, we've still got plenty of surprises in store for you. If you want to know which one I'm personally most looking forward to, I invite you to re-read our last article, in which you'll find a sneak preview of the next boss you might come across after this arc 2!

To conclude this letter, I'd also like to thank and welcome all the new Psycogs who join us every day. Mutants: Genesis is above all a community game that needs its players to thrive. If you're looking for other Psycogs to chat to, or if you're looking to take on the titans, I can only recommend that you join our Discord once again.

We hope to see you soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/a6dbef61e36b125be249a33f751e2ad1245ae555.jpg

So here we are guys, a new chapter opens up on the world of Mutants: Genesis! 

Let’s now dive into how this content will be released and what you can expect!

A new part of Chapter 2 will be released every 2 weeks, introducing a corporation, its leader and of course new cards, rewards and packs to get new skins or cardback! 
With 6 Genes, that’s more than 12 weeks of content coming up! Of course, a Chapter would not be complete without its boss. A special encounter that will offer a new challenge to existing and new players as well as as introducing a new Time Rift challenge!

As the new leader of the Panakeia team, you will have to travel around the world to be the very best. This will introduce you to new cards, corporation and gene specific strategies and of course, a cool fight with the leader of another team!

All new cards will be thematized around a Corporation specific gene, and so will be mono-gene! You’ll be able to collect 2 new mutants and a building or support card per Gene. So 18 new cards in total!

In addition to all of this, you will be able to purchase one of our Sponsorship Pack including:


 2 Skins
 An exclusive card back
 10 Gene specific capsules to get the new cards
 


A.S.A also told us that a Mega Sponsorship Bundle will be available with a special discount!

As you can see, there is lot to unpack in the coming weeks, and we are very excited to tell you that the first part of this Chapter will be out on the 17th of July! 

We’ll get the ball rolling with the Zoo gene and its corporation: Noah’s Ark!

Stay tuned for an article detailing this first release. We’ll see you soon Psycogs, get ready to the biggest content update to come yet!

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
As announced at the end of the last year, we've just released the Mobile version for Android and now that we have, many of you are no doubt wondering what we have planned for future updates of the game.

iOS Version

Players with iPhone should soon be able to join the other Psycogs, as we're in the process of finalizing this version, which requires a few more adaptations. Thank you all for your patience.

A Touch of Emotion

Many players have told us that they'd like to have more ways of communicating and expressing themselves during games, and the first step towards this is on the way: emotes. We're going to introduce a system of emotes that will make it a little easier to communicate your emotions in the middle of a game. 

These emotes will be based on the various characters you've already met in the course of the game, such as Victor and Zula.

Once new emotes are released, you'll be able to make your own selection of emotes available in the middle of combat, from the list of those you've unlocked. This will take place in a dedicated interface outside duels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/6075148dee311bc700200a7da83cd4c2baf199fa.png

Regarding this, let's move on to the next section, concerning the upcoming story chapter.

Junior Mutants League
 
At the end of the first chapter at the Panakéia orphanage, you were selected as Captain of your team after defeating Boris and Zula. Now it's time to test your skills against the other teams in the Junior Mutants League. The 6 most powerful teams in the league await you, each linked to one of the megacorporations at the centre of this universe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/64c3e5c117e1e4d72000c4c839321b1945e141d8.jpg

Will you be able to defeat them and become Junior Mutants League Champion? Whatever happens, Uncle Vic will be there to support you, Boris and Zula in the challenges ahead. 

This second chapter, which is longer than the previous one, will take place all over the world and will allow you to meet and face the other major teams in the league, while discovering their respective Captains, each with their own specialty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/706e562d6088ebae7cd7af69d2e7b562774a97b8.jpg

We've included much more lore about the universe in this second chapter, now that you've left the Panakéia Orphanage. And to reinforce the atmosphere of each of the major megacorporations in the Mutants: Genesis universe, we'll also be adding arenas specific to each Champion, here are two of them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/fb429a1c05085cbfaee3b16eaf3d3b04bda6d1d6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/3ba480f86ce5c461c01c9c58283229d0b37d9261.png

All these new battles will be accompanied by new unlockable cards, usable in all game modes, with new mutants specializing in a single gene. 

This chapter will be made available very soon, over the course of 6 patches, each containing one of the Junior Mutants League teams. All those fights will be playable in the order of your choice.

This chapter focuses on battles against other characters, but that won't be the only threat. There will also be a Boss to face.

Titanic Threats

Following the release of the content for the second chapter, we'll be unlocking access to the second Boss fight of Mutants: Genesis, which will take place in its own 2-level dungeon, to be completed in cooperation with other players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/8f5a06a5a9bbb87b262f20e6d8c59a944d1b3d58.jpg

This dungeon will be accessible directly from the map in the second chapter, and will require you to have progressed far enough in the story. 

Don't expect this new boss to be as kind to you as the Simulacrum was - this time the Titan will be a strange, savage creature ready to destroy everything in its path, and the dungeon is full of deadly dangers!

notes.title: Balance Patch - V 0.6.14
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balance patch!

Objectives

This patch, which takes place several months after the previous one, has enabled us to study the evolution of the meta over a longer period, in order to allow it a longer phase of self-regulation. As a result, we were able to see a high degree of stability in the Blades Orbs archetype at the top, with a few minor excesses on the Zoo side. We also saw a slump in the Space and Mystics decks. 

Balancing down (Nerfs) 📉 
___________________________________________________________________

Forged Orb


 The addition of Forged Orbs in previous drops allowed one Orbs archetype to work very, if not too effectively, particularly play for a One-Turn Kill. However, this was not the intended purpose of these orbs. So we decided to limit their power by removing their ATK bonus. 


Before: The equipped mutant has +1 ATK and +1 HP. 

After: The equipped mutant has +1 HP. 


El Gringo


 This pistolero is far too fast in both his attacks and his growth, allowing him to fire one shot after another and take very large quantities of EVO without risk. We've therefore decided to limit his growth rate and adjust his stats accordingly. 


Evolve curve: 1/2/3/4 → 2/3/4/5

EVO: 1/2/3/4/6 → 1/3/4/6/9

ATK: 2/3/4/5/7 → 2/4/5/6/8

PV: 2/3/4/5/7 → 2/4/5/6/8


Skirmish Tower


 The Orb Support Building has become too powerful with the emergence of Forged Orbs, as large numbers of them can be played via card effects. We're therefore adjusting the power of the Building to take account of this greater influx of Orbs. 


First Strike Capacity: 

Before: Passive - When you equip an Orb on a mutant, the Equipped mutant gets +2 ATK this turn.

After: Passive - When you equip an Orb on a Mutant, the Equipped Mutant gets +1 ATK this turn.


Mecharachnidian


 The heroic spider is at it again. We've analysed how the card is used, and we've decided to limit its direct impact a little by reducing its base stats slightly to make it more vulnerable and less dangerous. 


ATQ: 6 → 5

HP: 6 → 5

___________________________________________________________________

Upward Balancing (Buffs) 📈 

___________________________________________________________________


Behemoth


 The gigantic alien had a power with an alternating progression between an increase in attack bonus and HP bonus, making some of its ranks more effective defensively and others offensively. 


Heavy Security Ability:

Before: Architecture - For each Building on your field, this mutant has +1/1/2/2/3 ATQ and +0/1/1/2/3 HP.

After: Architecture - For each Building on your field, this mutant has +1/1/2/2/3 ATQ and +1/1/2/2/3 VP.


Gargantua


 This member of the trio formed with Tengu and Thor was less powerful than his fellows, being more specialised against buildings. As its damage potential is too limited, we're increasing the overall damage of its ability. 


Meteor Smash ability: 

Damage: 1/2/3/4/5 → 2/3/4/5/7


Lichlock


 This mutant's drawing power was slightly underestimated, given that the mutant takes time to incubate. We are therefore increasing its draw ability at all ranks. 


Forbidden Knowledge ability: 

Before: Testament - When this mutant is destroyed, draw 1/2/3/4/5 cards.

After: Testament - When this mutant is destroyed, draw 2/3/4/5/6 cards.

___________________________________________________________________

Functional modifications (Reworks) 📊

___________________________________________________________________

Reforge Keyword

Both Power Orb and Health Orb cards feature the Reforge mechanic, which allowed the player to draw a card when the equipped mutant was destroyed. However, this mechanic allowed you to cycle through your deck far too quickly in combination with the other cards dedicated to supporting Orbs. We've therefore decided to bring forward a change to the Reforge ability on these two cards, which will allow them to produce a Forged Orb instead of drawing. 

This will ensure a degree of stability in the way the cards linked to Orbs work, by ensuring that the card obtained when the Reforge ability is triggered is necessarily an Orb, without giving these orbs an overpowered advantage over the others. 

Reforge

Before: When the mutant to which this orb is equipped is destroyed, draw 1 card.

After: When the mutant to which this orb is equipped is destroyed, add a Forged Orb to your hand.

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch, and don't forget it'll be available on Wednesday, March 13th!

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis

notes.title: Balance Patch Season 4
notes.content:
Hello Psycogs!

Here's the balancing patch that will be released on Wednesday, November 22. Here are a few words from the Dev team to help you find out more, as well as the list of Buffs and Nerfs. 

Let's get started!


Objectives

In this patch, we've chosen to rebalance certain archetypes that had a few too many options for inflicting an OTK (One-Turn Kill, a combination of cards and actions to reduce the opponent's Psycore HP to 0 in a single turn) on the opponent and preparing for the release of new cards. In particular, the archetypes linked to Summoning had options that were a little too effective for the difficulty of setting them up. 

Balancing down (Nerfs) 📉 

___________________________________________________________________

Mephisto

 The demonic mutant has too much defensive capacity, as he uses summons to get better stats and his Evasion ability. We've decided to make it targetable again in standard situations. 

Evasion keyword: Removed

___________________________________________________________________

Battle Plan

 The support card for Mutants with Tactics has a power cap that is a little too high given that it has no cost. Rather than adding a cost to this card, we prefer to limit its excesses by adding a limit to the number of cards drawn.  

Draw effect: Limited to 3 cards. 

___________________________________________________________________

Mass Cannon
Like the previous card, the Mass Cannon has too high a power cap, given that the card is mainly used as a tool to end a game. We are therefore limiting its power to a maximum of 6 damage.

Damage inflicted by its effect: Limited to 6 damage. 

___________________________________________________________________

Bio Recycling

 The Bio Recycling card is a little too easy to use by sacrificing summons, so we've decided to limit its use to non-summoned mutants. 


Before: Destroy one of your mutants: Draw 2 cards.

After: Destroy one of your non-summoned mutants: Draw 2 cards.
___________________________________________________________________

Pandavinci

 The little painter panda proved to be a little too powerful in his defensive capacities in pvp. We have therefore decided to add a negative counterpart to his summoning. 


EVO given by Shinigami : 0 → 1

___________________________________________________________________

Sun-Duke

 Mutant Squad Commander Heroic was a little too effective on his own compared to his incubation time. We're therefore reducing the bonus he gets depending on the other mutants with Squad in the field. 


Fleet Commander ability: 

Before: This mutant has +2 ATK and +2 HP for each mutant with Squad on your field.  

After[/b ]: This mutant has +1 ATK and +1 HP for each mutant with Squad on your field.  

___________________________________________________________________

Upward Balancing (Buffs) 📈 

___________________________________________________________________

Cerberus

 The Soul Devouring Hellhound was sorely lacking in base power, so we've decided to increase its attack value at all ranks. 


Stats change: 

Attack : 1/3/4/6/7 → 2/4/5/8/9

___________________________________________________________________

Big Medpack

 This multi-target healing card had too little ability to heal compared to single-target alternatives such as the Intermediate Medkit.  We have decided to raise its heal value to make it more relevant in its role.


Heal : 4 → 6

___________________________________________________________________

Functional modifications (Reworks) 📊

___________________________________________________________________
 
Dreadnought

 The support ship of the Squad archetype was not able to function in the way we wanted in the current game environment. So we decided to reorient its operation as a major mutant of the Squad archetype, with the ability to fetch other mutants in your deck, while retaining the ability to attack

New stats

ATK: 7 → 7

HP: 8 → 7

Abilities

Armor Ability 2: Retained

Squad Ability: Retained

Support Platform Ability: Removed

Broadcast Orders Ability: Removed

Dual Core Ability added

Quick Teleport Ability added:

Action, Discard a Tech or Space mutant, or a Gadget card: Search your Deck for a non-Heroic mutant with Squad and put it into play. 

___________________________________________________________________

Strength in Numbers

 The support card for the Summon archetype gave a little too much direct impact and had too much OTK potential early in the game. We've therefore decided to revise the way it works to limit its short-term power. From now on, the card only gives +1 ATK to all your mutants, but this bonus persists after the end of the turn for your Summoned mutants. 


Before: Each mutant you control gets +1 ATK until end of turn. Each Summoned mutant gets an additional +1 ATK.

After: Each non-Summoned mutant you control gets +1 ATK until the end of the turn. Each Summoned mutant you control gets +1 permanent ATK instead. 

___________________________________________________________________

Zeus

 The god of lightning and king of Olympus was in his current form too powerful in the centre of certain OTK decks. We've therefore decided to completely overhaul his Divine Punishment ability and reorient it around an effect more related to his name, with the aim of punishing opposing actions, rather than encouraging the use of multiple cards with no possible opposing response. 


Divine Punishment Ability: 

Before: Whenever you or your opponent plays a card, this mutant deals 1 damage to each opposing Building and Psycore. 

After: Each time your opponent plays a card, this mutant inflicts 2 damage to each opposing Building and Psycore. 

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch, and don't forget it'll be available on Wednesday, November 22!

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis.

notes.title: Time Rifts - Shop and Cards
notes.content:
Greetings Psycogs!

This is the last of our Articles about the Time Rifts, which will be released on  November 8!

We will cover the Shop this time, as well as the new cards coming with this update!

THE TIME SHOP

Once you manage to beat any of the Weekly Time Rifts, you will be able to collect Rift Shards that will be specific to the minor mutation you have faced.

Those currencies will then allow you to buy multiple things like exclusive cosmetics and cards. There are 5 different Rift Shards and some items, including some exclusive and exciting cosmetics, will require Shards of multiple types!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/5790003c73604d2cc10a952e44bfa08c9e0b2231.png

NEW CARDS

Talking about cards, we have 7 of them joining the pool of Mutants: Genesis!

Let's introduce each of them with a quick commentary from our Game Director, Arthur "Docjackhal"!

Son of the Storm
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/02ee57204b79584497a4aca81d4b29eeea283a42.png

This new basic mutant is an essential asset in new stasis-based decks. Capable of sniping any target on your own and your allies' terrain each time they undergo a new stasis charge, Son of the Storm is a key mutant to protect.

You'll need to defeat Titans altered by the Electrostatic mutation to obtain it.


Buffalor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/4cf09bf7c4f072b02d943f9c2837da165a1637e6.png

This monstrous buffalo zombie is imbued with the Radioactive mutation, and will automatically disintegrate all opposing mutants whose attack reaches 0 or less. A new alternative way of dominating arenas.

You'll need to defeat titans altered by the Radioactive mutation to obtain it.


Stellarian Lithominer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/59780c83db549e70efa3f4bf6371da3a5d5db187.png

A veritable building smashing machine, it will devastate the opposing side of the arena every time you equip it with an orb or play a building.

You'll need to defeat titans altered by the Seismic mutation to get it.


Sorceress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/c6341cfec5bc1b088b2b273d0f6577b598d6da9f.png

An evil sorceress who can summon an army of zombies to protect herself. Hidden behind your other mutants, she'll wait for the fateful moment to strike and flood your opponent with a horde of the living dead.

You'll need to defeat titans altered by the Necroplague mutation to obtain it.


Data Snail
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/1dd7a7de37092a07c0463575bc6027c52d989d0d.png

Who hasn't dreamt of a giant snail with a cannon on its back? This Tech Snail will unleash a deluge of fire every turn as soon as a mutant evolves. It's enough to make your opponent's situation... explosive.

Singularity Wizard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/ef92b1e3885a1aeecd9760dac7ad491ed3e8c03f.png

This powerful magician can permanently erase an opposing mutant every turn. It's enough to give you a definitive advantage over your opponents and send them off into space.
You'll need to defeat numerous titans altered by the Electrostatic, Radioactive and Explosive mutations to obtain it.


Scarlett
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/2a7c40212869c7a942fa52ee42638523fcf1eb6c.png

Finally, the terrifying Scarlett enters the arena. A real asset to the Tactics decks and the Bones decks, her ability to survive and generate bones is sure to have a powerful impact in duels.
You'll need to defeat numerous titans altered by the Seismic, Necroplague and Explosive mutations to obtain it.


So here are the new cards and goodies coming up with the Time Rifts update on the 8th of November! We hope you'll enjoy them as much as we did creating them.

The Genesis Team

notes.title: Time Rifts: Mutations
notes.content:
Greetings Psycogs!

In a serie of two articles, we'll be detailing our next major update: the Time Rifts, coming up on the 8th of November!

Our first article is about Mutations which are the key elements of this new PvE mode. Titans (or bosses) will be available to challenge in a weekly rotation of both an Inferior or Superior Rift, resetting each Monday.

The Inferior Rift will have the Titan affected by one of the Minor Mutations whereas the Superior Rift will get both a Minor Mutation and a Superior One. 

To unlock this new PvE challenge, you'll have to have defeated the Weekly Boss in Normal first.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/5e896b1e3ce9b598909c4635147cea344ef46a4c.png

INFERIOR MUTATIONS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9a712d103ee9c57d288b11513eea9a351efc5706.png

Let's start with one you'll recognize through its blue hue and electrical surrounding: THE ELECTROSTATIC MUTATION. Here are the effects of this mutation:

At the end of the turn of the players and of the boss, a random mutant or building on the opponent's board suffers Stasis 3.

Additionally, when a mutant or a building in stasis is destroyed, all the player's mutants suffer as much damages as the number of Stasis stacks.

You'll have to keep an eye on who has Stasis and play around it in order not to trigger devastating chains of destructions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/d310ffca14113df8dda5eea1abf7e61adb306713.png

You then have THE RADIOACTIVE MUTATION!

This one will be terrible for Mutant heavy decks:

At the end of the player's turn, all opposing mutants suffer -1 ATK.
When a mutant has 0 ATK it is automatically destroyed and this is not affected by Stasis!

Once again, purification effects will be key as well as making sure your Mutants do not reach 0 Attack!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/4bac6ba12a65c5b8df53c6481ed96ae0e2711841.png

THE SEISMIC MUTATION is sure to make each player quake!

Each time a building comes into play, all non-Psycore buildings take 2 damage, and the player who played the building takes 2 damage. But in order to put players on a timer, at the start of each boss's turn, the Psycores each take 2 damage, dealing a whooping 6 damages at 3 players!

Buildings will have to be limited with this mutation and you'll have to go fast in order not to lose to the seismic waves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/b9fba976d716bde4e5478b279c61167eaad5e01c.png

If earthquakes weren't your thing, you'll have THE NECROPLAGUE MUTATION to deal with! This one is quite simple:

When a mutant is destroyed, summon 1 basic Zombie for the boss. Don't be (too) afraid, the Zombie won't summon another Zombie but still it's very easy to get swamped under the undead!

Trades will have to be thoughtful and efficient for you to survive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/59d0651b1eb58cf9dc9d0401708cd0fd05d2bdb9.png

This is another simple effect: THE DETONATING MUTATION !

When a mutant or building is destroyed on a board, it explodes and inflicts 1 damage to the entire board and the opposing board.

When you are against this mutation, you have to make sure not to trigger a chain reaction of explosive proportions. So you have to make the proper choice between destroying mutants or attacking the boss!

But that's not all, if you face the Superior Rifts, you'll have to deal with a combo of a Minor Mutation and Major one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/6c08423e309ce3695586839b75d1ba6e6ae1ec88.png

MAJOR MUTATIONS

Major Mutations transform the challenge of Time Rifts to make it more difficult. In addition to Minor Mutations, they can cause very interesting twists on the fights!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/4262e5a0c7250cebd96ccae8343beb1ea79f760e.png

The Titan now has armour, but wait! Its Mutants too. This makes every Trade more difficult as things are more tough, needing you to have a harder hit force.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/38a1680fa6f5228c979eb6dfffa14c83aebc9d06.png

All Mutants from an Enraged Titan will have +2 ATK. Now imagine this with the NECROPLAGUE MUTATION and you will realize how dangerous it can be. Just like the Metalic Titan, it will make you think about trades!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/0c439bcfba0a339979d827c3916d4b7c01db2b2f.png

When the Titan is Colossal, it has +100% HP. Making it twice as resistant. This will cause multiple abilities to trigger several times. Rushing it down is even more difficult and what could be a sprint fight becomes an enduring one!


Here are all the Mutations from the new Time Rifts! As you can see, this will bring us to a total of 15 different combos for Superior Rifts! A real weekly challenge that we hope you will enjoy.

The Genesis Team

notes.title: Season 3 Balance Patch
notes.content:
Hello Psycogs!

Here is the next balancing patch that will be live on Wednesday, October 4. As usual, here are a few words from the Dev team to find out more, as well as the list of Buffs and Nerfs. 

Let's dive right in!

Objectives

2023’s season 2 was far more balanced, at least in terms of deck diversity. However, Zoo decks (and at a lesser scale, Tech decks) still have a dominating presence in the PvP scene over the others, and Mystic decks are the least favored child.

Downward balancing (Nerfs)

___________________________________________________________________

Beast

 The Zoo Psycore based on the Beast starter keeps on being the most played Starter since season 1. Its ability do deal damage on the opposing battlefield (even if a bit unreliably) makes it often a first choice starter, overshadowing most basic Zoo mutants. We chose to weaken it by making it far more random and risky, in the line of Zoo’s randomness. 


Midnight Fangs Ability
BEFORE
When this mutant enters play/evolves, it deals [1-1-1-2-3] damage to a random opposing entity. 

AFTER
When this mutant enters play/evolves, it deals [1-1-1-2-3] damage to another random entity on your or your opponent’s battlefield.

___________________________________________________________________

Scrap-Metal Cannon

 The Scrap-Metal Cannon is too efficient in its ability to target and destroy the opposing Psycore, bypassing Guardian Buildings and Mutants. To limit that card’s power in PvP and Siege battles, we make it able to target only Mutants. 


BEFORE
Discard any number of Tech mutants or Parts cards. Deal 2 piercing damage to target entity for each discarded card. 

AFTER
Discard any number of Tech mutants or Parts cards. Deal 2 piercing damage to target mutant for each discarded card. 

Note : The Scrap-Metal cannon still works on the Battle Simulacrum, as it’s a Mutant. 

___________________________________________________________________

Laser Printer

 The Laser Printer is a very effective Building to fill your board with Starter mutants. We limit its long-term generation so that the Old Printer remains a viable alternative.


New stats : HP reduced from [3] to [2]

___________________________________________________________________

Upward balancing (Buffs)

___________________________________________________________________

Cerberus

 Cerberus was lightly understatted, we upped its ATK in consequence. 


New stats : ATK increased from [1-3-4-6-7] to [2-4-5-7-8]

___________________________________________________________________

Dilophoraptor

 We determined temporary ATK penalties were not as powerful as we expected them to be, so we make them permanent. 


Blinding Toxin ability
BEFORE
When this mutant enters play/evolves, inflict -[1-2-2-3-100] ATK on a random oppposing mutant until the end of turn.

AFTER
When this mutant enters play/evolves, inflict -[1-2-2-3-100] ATK on a random oppposing mutant.

___________________________________________________________________

Wicked Witch

 As per Dilophoraptor, we make its ATK penalty permanent, without changing its stats, while adjusting the ability power at Platinum rank, as this one was already permanent. 


Murder of Crows ability:
BEFORE
Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with -[1-1-2-2] ATK until the end of turn.
Platine : Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with -[2] ATK.

AFTER
Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with  -[1-1-2-2-3] ATK.

___________________________________________________________________

Wrath

 Wrath was lightly understatted, and had a low survivability in most cases. We increase its HP at all ranks.


New stats : HP increased from [2-3-5-7-9] to [3-4-6-8-10]

___________________________________________________________________

Stealth Bot

 This mutant had a very situational ability. We decided to add it a small Stasis effect at Basic and Bronze ranks to both align it with other ranks and make its evolution more understandable.
 

The Backstab and Electric Backstab abilities are merged into one. 
BEFORE

Action - Deal [1-2-2-3-4] and Stasis [0-0-2-2-2] to target mutant. Stealth-Bot loses Evasion until the beginning of your next turn. 

AFTER

Action - Deal [1-2-2-3-4] and Stasis [1-1-2-2-2] to target mutant. Stealth-Bot loses Evasion until the beginning of your next turn. 

___________________________________________________________________

Set Ablaze

 Even though that card’s power level on the long term was quite correct (6 damage over 3 turns), the card suffered greatly in comparison with all other forms of single-target direct damage or destruction. We increased its offensive ability to give it the ability to exert long-term pressure on powerful mutants.
 


BEFORE

Discard a Mystic Mutant: Inflict Burning 3 to target mutant.

AFTER

Discard a Mystic Mutant: Inflict Burning 4 to target mutant.

___________________________________________________________________

The Forgotten One

 This Heroic Necro mutant has been part of the forgotten ones (pun intended) during this ranked season. We decided to improve it by simplifying her Eternal Despair ability, which now applies both stat increases when a mutant is destroyed, and we gave her a brand new effect. We adjusted its stats accordingly.


New Stats: HP reduced from [9] to [8]

Eternal Despair ability

BEFORE
Whenever a mutant you control is destroyed, this mutant has +1 ATK. Whenever an opposing mutant is destroyed, this mutant has +1 HP.

AFTER

Whenever another mutant is destroyed on your or your opponent’s battlefield, this mutant has +1 ATK, +1 PV and your Psycore is healed by 1.

___________________________________________________________________


Mechanical changes (Reworks)

___________________________________________________________________


Monocerus

 Monocerus has been part of the most played mutants since the first ranked season, despite a first modification of its ability. Given the huge number of Zoo/Tech Basic mutants, we decided to change Monocerus to an advanced mutant, in order to balance the distribution of such mutants. Its stats have been rebalanced according to the new design. 


Mutant Subtype: Basic → Advanced

New Stats:

Evolution Curve: EVO necessary to evolve : Increased from [1-2-3-4] to [2-3-4-5]

EVO given on destruction : Increased from [1-2-3-4-6] to [2-3-4-6-9]

ATK: Reduced from [2-3-5-8-10] to [2-3-4-6-8]

HP: Increased [2-3-6-9-11] to [3-5-7-10-12]


That's it for this patch, don't forget that it will be available wednesday 4th of october!

Have a great game,

Team Genesis.

notes.title: Mutants: Genesis - Balance Patch Season 2
notes.content:
Dear Psycogs,

Welcome to this second balance patch. You'll find Nerfs and Buffs and reworks of certain cards.

This patch is already deployed!


Objectives

Season 2 was far better balanced in terms of deck composition. However, we continue to see Zoo decks having a domineering position over the others. 

This balance patch main objective is to lessen Zoo impact so that the current meta changes, and give a push to two deck archetypes currently absent in the competitive scene : Boneyard and Tactics.


NERFS



 Cernunnos


Cernunnos currently has too high statistics. Instead of reducing these statistics, we increase the EVO required to evolve. 

Evolution curve : 

EVO necessary to evolve increases from [1-2-3-4] to [3-4-5-7].


 Solar Lampyrion


The previous rework of Solar Lampyrion made it a lot stronger, but too versatile. We rebalance its overall potential by reducing its offensive power, without changing its support ability. 

New statistics: ATK reduced from [8] to [6]

Solar Eruption ability: Area damage reduced from [3] to [2]


 Rakshasa


This mutant introduced in the Pioneer Drop is currently too powerful with the Forged Orb generation. To reduce its raw power, we slightly reduce its HP value and introduce a limitation to its Unsheathe ability.

New statistics: 

HP reduced from [3-5-7-8-9] to [2-4-6-7-8]

Tiger Rage ability: 

Before

Unsheathe - Whenever this mutant is equipped with an Orb, it deals damage equal to its ATK to a random opposing mutant. 

After

Unsheathe - Once per turn, when this mutant is equipped with an Orb, it deals damage equal to its ATK to a random opposing mutant. 


 Genshiryoku


This mutant had a too massive impact as soon as it arrived in play, especially in Zoo archetypes able to trigger Kaiju domination during a single turn through support cards. 

New statistics: 

HP reduced from [3-5-7-10-13] to [2-4-6-9-12] 

ATK reduced from [3-5-7-9-11] à [2-4-6-8-10]

Kaiju Domination ability: 

ATK bonus reduced from [1-2-2-3-3] to [1-1-2-2-3]. 

HP bonus reduced from [1-1-2-3-3] to [1-1-2-2-3]


 Leviathan


Contrary to our previous announcement in July, the damage of Leviathan’s Tsunami at Bronze rank have not changed. We realign them according to the announcement.

Tsunami ability: 

Area Damage to Buildings reduced from [1-2-2-2-3] to [1-1-2-2-3]


 Defensive Shield


This is the most-played buiding in the game. We have decided to increase the EVO given when it is destroyed to mitigate its current impact in game, especially in PvP, while keeping its defensive PvE potential against Bosses. 

EVO given on destruction: Increased from [2] to [3]


 The Anvil


The Anvil was able to produce too many Forged Orbs over a too long duration. We limited the generation potential to 3 Orbs over 3 turns. 

Auto-Smithing ability: 

Self-Damage increased from [1] to [2]

New statistics: 

PV increased from [5] to [6]


BUFFS



 Azog


This mutant had a passive ability with an extremely situational impact. We decided to add it a new Tactics ability, allowing it better possibilities to interact with Mystic decks, while adjusting its statistics towards its defense. 

New statistics: 

ATK reduced from [3-5-7-11-14] to [2-4-5-7-10]

HP increased from [3-5-6-7-10] to [3-5-6-8-12]

New ability:

Chamanic Strength - Tactics - While you control a Mutant with an Active ability, this mutant has +[2-3-4-5-7] ATK. 


 Marship Mallow


This mutant was weaker than planned at the Basic rank, so we slightly improve its attack. 

New statistics: 

ATQ increased from [1-2-4-6-7] to [2-2-4-6-7]


 Ghostmonaut


The ability of this mutant used to trigger when one of your buildings was destroyed. Even though it had Evasion, it was usually far more interesting to destroy it before attacking buildings. Its new version deals a little less damage, but now applies when a building on either your or your opponent’s battlefield is destroyed, allowing it to be played in Space archetypes revolving around Cityscape, Deployment and Demolition.

Space Debris ability: 

Before

Passive - Whenever one of your buildings is destroyed, this mutant deals [2-2-3-4-6] damage to the opposing mutant with the lowest HP. 

After

Passive - Whenever a Building on either your or your opponent's battlefield is destroyed, this mutant deals [1-1-2-3-5] damage to the opposing mutant with the lowest HP. 


 Bushi


As all mutants with Boneyard abilities, its ability didn’t reward enough the risks taken to activate it. We readjusted its statistics and focused its ability towards a better offensive power. 

New statistics: 

ATK increased from [2-2-4-6-9] to [2-3-5-7-9] 

HP reduced from [2-4-6-8-10] to [2-3-5-7-9]

Veterancy ability: 

Before

Boneyard - While you have at least 10 cards in your Discard, this mutant has +[2-2-3-4-6] ATK and +[2-2-3-4-6] HP.

After

Boneyard - While you have at least 10 cards in your Discard, this mutant has +[2-3-4-5-7] ATK.


 Dead Bot


As all mutants with Boneyard abilities, its ability didn’t reward enough the risks taken to activate it. We decided to increase the Armor bonus given by its ability, granting it a huge potential to attack other mutants. 

Reactive Shielding ability: 

Armor bonus increased from [1-1-2-2-4] à [2-2-3-4-5]


 Mirror Reflector


This building was not very popular, due to its complex triggering conditions and a random targeting. We changed its targeting to focus weaker mutants to give it more offensive capabilities. 

Energy Inverter ability:

Before

Whenever one of your mutants is healed, deal 1 damage to a random opposing mutant. 

After

Whenever one of your mutants is healed, deal 1 damage to the opposing mutant with the lowest HP.


 Drill Orb


Due to the appearance of the Forged Orb, we improved it to give it an edge over the generated Orb card. 

New statistics: 

HP bonus while equipped to a mutant increased from [0] to [1]


REWORKS



 Warrior


This starter mutant had a Tactics ability with a harsh activation condition, making it too complex to play efficiently. We changed its ability to have its attack bonus while a mutant is on the opposing battlefield. 

Sanguinary ability: 

Before

Tactics - While an opposing mutant is damaged, this mutant has +[1-1-2-3-4] ATK.

After

Tactics - While your opponent controls a mutant, this mutant has +[1-1-2-3-4] ATQ.


 Charon


The guardian of the Styx was too slow and unefficient in its previous role. Now as a guardian of Hell, it has a Boneyard ability giving it a massive attack bonus while active. 

Stygian Flows ability:

Before

Passive - Whenever a card enters your opponent’s Discard, this mutant has +[1] ATK.

After

Boneyard - While you have at least 10 cards in your discard, this mutant has +[6] ATK. 


 Commander Ender


As all mutants with Boneyard abilities, its ability didn’t reward enough the risks taken to activate it. We reworked this mutant to improve its terrifying side. The mutant is now an Advanced mutant, has its statistics readjusted accordingly, and now also applies an attack penalty to opposing mutants in addition to its autorepair bonus. It now no longer has additional HP depending on allied discards content. 

Mutant Subtype: Basic → Advanced

Evolution curves: 

EVO necessary to evolve: [2-3-4-5]

EVO given on destruction increases from [1-3-4-6-9] to [2-3-4-6-9]

New statistics: 

ATQ changes to [2-4-6-8-10] 

PV changes to [3-5-6-8-11]

Unstoppable ability: 

Before 

For each allied discard pile that contains at least 10 cards, this mutant has Autorepair [1-1-1-2-3] and  +[0-0-1-2-3] PV.

After

For each allied discard pile that contains at least 10 cards, this mutant has Autorepair [1-1-2-2-3] and opposing mutants have -[1-1-1-2-3] ATK. 

That's it for this patch,

Hope you'll enjoy it! Have a great day!

Team Mutants Genesis

notes.content:
Hello Psycogs! Welcome back to Psycog: 101!

Victor, your favorite coach and teacher at the Panakeïa Orphanage will be with us again, hello Victor!

"Hello everyone! Always a pleasure to be with you."

Today we're going to talk about Heroic Cards, the highest rarity in Mutants: Genesis.

"These cards are so rare that they can only be played once in your decks!"

That's right! When Heroic Cards are Mutants, they must be incubated most of the times! This incubation time is usually ranging from 2 to 4 turns.

"But there are also Heroic Cards that aren't Mutants, and I think we'll take a look at those too."

Let's start by dwelling on the Heroics you'll get when you manage to beat Victor and all of his different Gene decks during the Campaign before diving in the rest of the collection  available.

Without any preference whatsoever, let's start with Mystic!

"Sure..."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/2b107f3201dd79dd0a3ecbc317b1034d9b581ebc.png

Geomega is a card that requires 3 Turns to incubate, that's a long time! So it will have its place in a rather Control deck or one that can deal with the board!

"And if you don't know what a Control deck is we invite you to read one of the articles we did, right here."

Geomega has a devastating active power which makes it a Heroic that works very well on its own or in decks that capitalize on active powers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/527be506c3f7685afd31269e1115d10b14e6eacc.png

"Zeus is the first heroic card in the Space Decks. He specializes in destroying buildings!"

And on top of that, it's got some serious stats. Why so serious by the way?

"Ahem... Undeads are pretty much serious, look at the Forgotten One!"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/8f00e6c3216191199d326d70b8fe14aec6d10c54.png

This card has Guardian, which coupled to its abilities makes it a very tenacious element of the field. This card is perfect for decks that want a big threat and have the means to temporize its arrival.

Now let's talk about Blades' Heroics!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/573c26f3b31cce4dd75725c91bb80f34fa6e53a2.png

"This is Spartaaaaaaaac! Oops... Sorry."

Spartac s a card that fits into Blades Decks, which focus on Orbs. It can become extremely powerful very quickly, thanks to its ability to tutor an Orb and play it on himself. Once again, however, it will take 3 turns for it to arrive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/744082db0ed89b44d583092c0e872f51352fad92.png

Goliath is the Heroic Tech by definition. It will boost itself when Parts are played on it.

"What's more, the addition of Guardian on this card makes it a living wall and justifies its incubation time."

Well Victor, I guess I'll let you announce this one....

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/6605b6d46927bb81aafa6a7e03ad4c9ac1e30d59.png

"The Solar Lampyrion! THE Zoo Heroic and my favorite. This pretty beast has no equal when it comes to cleaning up the grounds, a bit like Geomega but... better!"


Let's say it's different, Solar Lampyrion has great stats but needs to attack to apply its effect. His passive also allows Mutants to evolve more quickly and can therefore turn the game around very quickly.

Then, of course, there are other heroic Mutants in each gene, which we'll take a look at one after the other.


    MYSTIC


"This is your favourite Gene, isn't it?"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/e7990be56f91e1ebf733647cb8210c7da72f4daa.png

That's right! Gorthaur and the Shadow of Kukulkan are the other two mainly Mystic Heroic Mutants. Both fit into a Burn Deck logic but don't have exactly the same power and Body, you can also play Lady Cidohna who we'll talk more about with the Necros.

"Body" is the somewhat barbaric term for a card's set of stats. The higher its stats, the more qualitative it is. A bit like me!"

What's important to define when integrating a Heroic into your deck is its rhythm. You need to know whether the number of turns required to incubate it can be easily managed without resorting to Advanced Mutants.


    SPACE


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/85a5202e76ba8f06f9706d71da726619bf929f59.png

Dreadnought is the other Heroic mainly Space and playable by this gene.

"It will fit easily into Techs and Squad Decks to capitalize on its two abilities."

Sun-Duke is another mutant with both genes, but we'll talk more about that in Blades! Darwin can also be integrated into Space Decks, but I'll let Victor explain it better with the focus on Zoo Heroes.


    NECRO


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/7ed30c10d7a26bab37c78416d7f3cf0afb6bb3a4.png

"Charon and Lady Cliodhna are quite unique! You've got to admit that among the Necros, the Heroics really have style."

Charon's mechanic is based on discarding cards, which is very original for the moment, but can make it a formidable card that turns certain games upside down, depending on what's going to be discarded.

Lady Cliodhna is a perfect fit for a deck with active powers, or one that needs to make effective trades thanks to its ability.

We mustn't forget Neo-Urban XIII, but we'll come back to it when we talk about Techs!


    BLADES


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/b8f603a20aad43c99149c76704f6599efdfcc975.png

Spartac is the true poster child of this gene, but he can be accompanied in decks by Sun Duke for the union between Blades and Space in Squad decks, whose stats make him a formidable foe after just 2 turns! Gorthar can add a little indirect damage and burn effects!

Charon is also a possibility, making Blade Decks rather flexible, with Heroics with 2 Incubation Turns and effects that don't depend on specific mechanics!


    TECH


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/fc8d127865e1974b8331a24990892f1b4f1fed24.png

"Ah techies, always playing with their Parts. But it's pretty damn effective!"

Mecharachnidian and Neo-Urban XIII join the mainly Techs heroics.

"The former has a very zoo feel, who wouldn't want to look like a spider? Mecharachnidian fits in very well with games around Auto-Repair and is an immediate threat when she arrives on the field!"

Neo-Urban XIII is a substantial bodysuit too but above all, a time bomb that forces your opponent to make disadvantageous choices to deal with it.

Dreadnought can also be integrated into Tech Decks to benefit from its Parts effect.


    ZOO


"THE BE(A)STS!"

We suspected as much Victor...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/8a6101b78fd493262026240f494cf48fc140a8f3.png

"We're back with Mecharachnidian, whom I was telling you about earlier! His skills and stats make him a very good choice whatever the direction of the Deck. Darwin is slower, but his ability to provoke numerous evolutions makes him formidable!""

And finally, the Shadow of Kukulkan offers the possibility of Burning opponents with Zoos cards!

"And what's more, it's a big snake!!! I love it!!!"


As you can see, there are 4 Heroic Mutant options per Gene. Each of them has a big impact when they come into play. To choose, try to maximize the synergies they offer with the rest of your Deck, but also pay attention to the incubation time! Many Heroic cards invite you to build decks around particular gene combinations.

"If you have a rather Aggro Deck, favor short incubation times, for example!"

And on the contrary, the more Control you are, the more Heroics with a slow incubation you can integrate in youir deck!

Finally, there are two cards that are not Mutants: Portal of the Void and Revival!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/d3f12ecc78bb88a080a8ac90ded7d4e34cb1732b.png

The first is an excellent Removal, which we already mentioned in our article about them. As for Revivifying, it's a very practical card that allows you to potentially play several Basic Mutants in a single turn! Use it at the right moment and you're guaranteed an effective board!

Here you are for a roundup of the Heroic Cards! We hope you liked it!

"See you later for more articles!"

See you soon Psycogs!

Team Mutants: Genesis

notes.title: Mutants: Genesis - Balancing Patch Season 1
notes.content:
Dear Psycogs, 

Welcome to this first Card Balance Patch! Season 1 2023 was dominated by Zoo decks including  Beast as well as Tech Decks.
The objective of this balancing was to reverse the meta and push new deck archetypes forward while lowering the impact of the most present decks.

You'll be introduced to Nerfs and Buffs. Respectively modifications to make a card less or more powerful.

This patch will be online Wednesday 19 2023!

Let's go together through the details:

CARDS NERFS


Beast

Beast is one of the most powerful and played starter mutant.  We are lowering the damages of its evolving ability in higher ranks to lower its impact in ultra agressive Zoo decks.

Ability Midnight Fang : Damages reduced from [1-1-2-3-4] to [1-1-1-2-3]


 Monocerus

Monocerus was initially planned to be played in multiplayer modes. Still, its ability to generate a lot of Parts, even if its just Repair Nanites, make it too powerfull as a Part generator in PvP. We'll be lowering its ability to generate parts in higher ranks and adjust its stats accordingly.

Ability Nanites Production : Number of parts reduced from [1-1-2-3-4] to [1-1-1-1-2]

New Stats:
ATK - [2-3-5-7-10] → [2-3-5-8-10]
HP - [2-3-5-7-10] → [2-3-6-9-11]


 Cyber-Croc

Just as Monocerus, Cyber-Croc's ability to generate parts without any cost make it a staple of Tech-Gadget decks. We'll be lowering its ability to generate Parts and raise the number of EVO needed to its evolution. Stats are adjusted accordingly.

Note : Its stats and the number of EVO given will be adjusted with its new evolution curb.

Ability Mechanisation : Number of parts reduced from [1-1-2-3-4] to [1-1-1-2-3]

Evolution curb : EVO needed to evolve [1-2-3-4] to [2-3-4-5]


New Stats:
ATK - [2-3-5-7-10] → [2-3-6-8-11]


 Leviathan

Star of OTK Zoo deck before our hotfix of Natural Selection and Savage Strike, Leviathan remains a very powerful mutant able to combo with itself. We'll be lowering the damages of its ability to make it harder to evolve it in quick successions in order to destroy all the buildings and damage heavily the psycore.

Ability Tsunami : Damages reduced from [1-2-2-3-4] to [1-1-2-2-3]



 Cernunnos

Cernunnos' stats were a bit too high. We'll be lowering its attack to put it back in a correct progression curve.

New Stats: ATK lowered from [2-4-6-8-10] to [2-3-5-7-9]

CARDS BUFFS


 Thor

Thor's abilities have been reinforced to better work with themslves and make the mutant stronger while rewarding players who discard cards from both genes.

Ability Thunder Shock

Before
If you've discarded a Blade mutant, inflicts damages to all other mutants on the target's field.
After
If you've discarded a Blade mutant, inflicts [1-1-2-2-3] to the target and all other mutants on the field.

Ability Lightning Bolt

Before
If you've discarded a Mystic mutant, inflicts Stasis to the target Mutant.
After
If you've discarded a Mystic mutant, inflicts Stasis [1-1-2-2-3] to all affected Mutants.

Stats adjustment: 
HP : [3-5-6-9-12] → [3-5-7-9-12]


 Cursed Mausoleum

The ability Cursed Mausoleum has been modified to have an immediate impact when it arrives on the field.

Before
At the end of your turn, create a Bones card in your discard.

After
When it enters play and at the start of the turn, create a Bones card in your discard.


 Catacomb Excavation

The number of Bones created has been upped.

Before
Create 2 Bones in your discard.

After
Create 3 Bones in your discard.


 Howlosaurus

The second Zoo starter suffers from its opposition to Beast. Stats have been balanced to make it more polyvalent.

New Stats:
ATK: [1-1-2-2-3] to [1-2-3-4-6]
HP: [1-3-4-6-9] to [1-2-3-4-6]


 The Forgotten

The basic heroic of the Necro gene suffers from a lack of impact when it arrives in game. Giving it the 
Guardian ability forces the opponent to sacrifice mutants against it, fuelling its ability.

New Keyword: Guardian


 Zeus

The basic heroic of the Space gene gets a new defensive aspect to capitalize on its ability.

New Stats: 
HP: 8 => 7

Ability added: 
Olympos : Architecture - While you have a building, Zeus has Armor 2


 Lady Cliodhna

The banshee queen gets a new defensive keyword. Her HP stats have been adapted in consequence.

New Stats: 
HP : 7 => 6

New Keyword: Evasion.



 Darwin

The negative effect of its Rush ability was not rewarding players that were able to summon Darwin. His ability has been modified to entirely remove the negative effect. His stats have been slightly adjusted to account for this change.

Ability Evolution Theory

Before
When Darwin enters play, each other Mutants on the field gains 3 EVO and Darwin looses 1ATK and 1HP for each affected mutant.

After
When Darwin enters play, each other Mutants on the field gains 3 EVO.

Modified Stats:
ATK : 13 => 12
HP : 13 => 12


 Shade of Kukulkàn

Shade of Kukulkàn has a very powerful effect when he arrives in play but his threat level diminishes afterward. A new ability has been added.

New Ability:
Persisting Flames: Passive - At the start of the turn, inflicts Burn 2 to all opposing mutants.


 Dreadnought

The defensive ability of Dreadnought has been reinforced. Its stats have been adapted in consequence.

Modified Stats:
HP : 10 => 8

New Keyword: Armor 2


 Tengu

Like Thor, Tengu's ability has been modified to offer better combos with its 2 other effects.

NOTE : Tengu will be updated in the next patch as we've encountered some technical issues that prevented it from being released today (19/07).

Ability Amnesia

Before
If you've discarded a Zoo mutant, this mutant gains X EVO, X ATK and X HP.

After
If you've discarded a Zoo mutant, this mutant gains X EVO, X ATK and X HP for every target hit.


 Soul Pit

The power of Soul Pit has been upped to put it in the same level as cards like Missile Turret or Imperishable Blaze. 

Before
When a mutant with Last Will you control is destroyed, inflicts 1 damage to the opposing Psycore.

After
When a mutant with Last Will you control is destroyed, inflicts 2 damages to the opposing Psycore.


 Incubator Pod

The resistance of the Incubator Pod has been upped to make it more difficult to destroy mutants incubating in it.

New Stats:
HP: 4 => 5


CARDS REWORK


Ability Ignite

The Ignite ability was a bit too weak defensively speaking. We are modifying the way it works so it triggers when your Mutants are attacked as well:

Ability modification:

Before:
Ignite X - Everytime this Mutant attacks another Mutant, it also inflicts Burn X.

After:
Ignite X - Everytime this Mutant inflicts battle damage, it also inflicts Burn X.

Concerned Cards:


 Demon
 Pit Lord
 Gorthaur the cruel
 Kung Chow
 Steam Warlord



 Pit Lord


Following changes made to Ignite, the passive ability of Pit Lord became obsolete. He now has a new Aura ability.

Ability Incandescent  - Removed
Ability Inferno - Modified

Before
Aura - Double Burn effects on ennemy Mutants (Only at Platinum rank)

After
Aura - All your Mutants have Ignite [1-1-1-2-3]


 Mecharachnidian

Mecharachnidian wasn't working properly. It became a highly played card because its stats where too high because of how its ability worked. 
The card has been reworked to fit its initial design : one of a menace that transforms with time.

New Stats:
ATK: 6, HP: 6, Armor 3

Ability Shapeshifting: Changes

Before: 
Passive - At the start of your turn, this mutant has +6 ATQ until the end of the turn. At the start of your opponent's turn, this mutant has Armor 3 until the end of the turn.

After:
Passive - When this mutant takes damage, it loses all its Armor stacks. While this mutant has no Armor, it has +3 ATK and Autorepair 3.


 Gargantua

Gargantua's abilities have been entirely changed to make it more polyvalent.

Ability Meteor Strike
Base Damages:[1-2-3-4-5]

Ability Direct Impact

Before:
If you've discarded a Space mutant, inflicts additionnal damages to the target.

After:
If you've discarded a Space mutant, deals damage to all ennemy buildings in addition to the target.

Ability Sismic Wave

Before :
If you have discarded a Tech mutant, deals damages to all buildings on the target field.

After :
If you've discarded a Tech mutant, generates [1-1-2-2-3] Parts depending on the number of targets hit.

New Stats:

ATK : [3-5-7-9-12] → [2-4-6-8-10]


 Goliath

Goliath 's ability could be frustrating because a lot of Parts cards couldn't see their effects doubled. He got reinforced to become more defensive and decisive. 

New Keyword: Guardian

Ability Advanced Robotic

Before:
Double the effects of the Parts played on him
After:
Goliath earns +1HP Max et +1 Autorepair each time a Part is played on him.


 Neo-Urban XIII

Neo-Urban XIII was suffering from 2 problems: he didn't have enough impact in Necro decks and wasn't impactful enough when he arrived after 4 turns of incubation. His base ability is reinforced and a new ability replace the previous one.

Ability Violent Extraction

Before:
Execution: When this mutant destroys another mutant, create 2 Parts in your hand.

After :
Exécution: When this mutant destroys another mutant, create 3 Parts in your hand.

Ability Artificial Life

Before:
Passive - When a Part is played on this mutant, it gains ATK, HP and Autorepair.

After:
Last Will: When Neo-Urban XIII is destroyed, if it's not your turn, it deals its ATK to the main opposing entity.


 Void Turret

The offensive potential of Void Turret was too weak compared to other options. Its ability has been modified.

Before:
Collapse: When this building is destroyed, inflicts 3 to the mutant that attacked it.

After:
Collapse: When this building is destroyed, inflicts 3 piercing damage to a random opposing mutant.


 Valkyrie

Valkyrie had trouble to find its place in any archetype. A new Tactics ability has been added to help it find a place in an archetype. A new Last Will has been added to ease it's integration in Blade decks while keeping its invocation theme.

New Ability: 
Valhalla's Bond : Tactics - If you have a Warrior on the field, all your blade mutants have +[1-1-2-2-3] ATK 

New Stats:
HP: [1-2-2-3-5] à [0-1-1-2-3]


 Solar Lampyrion

Solar Lampyrion was too hard to deal with and plan with. Its ability has been simplified to make it more easy to use.

Ability Solar Eruption

Before:
Passive - When this mutant attacks, share all damages inflicted among all opposing entities.

After:
Passive - When this mutant attacks, deal 3 damages to all opposing entities.

New Stats: 
ATK : 8 → 8
HP : 10 → 10


 Second Chance

Rework of the card to work with the Bones archetype.

Before:

Discard a Necro mutant: Invoke a Zombie.

After:
Discard a Necro mutant: Invoke a Silver Rank Ossembly.


Here you go for this patch!

Again, it will be out Wednesday 19th July and we can't wait to see which decks you'll build!

Have a great day!

Team Genesis

All players start at Bronze IV.

notes.title: Early access update patchnote
notes.content:
Dear Psycogs, 
The big day has arrived! Mutants: Genesis is now available on Steam. You will find below our first patchnote, related to this early access release. 

Thank you for your support and enjoy our game!

The Mutants: Genesis team

Early Access Patchnote - May 10th, 2023.

Mechanics changes
A number of new keywords have been introduced in the game, either to clarify how some abilities work, or because enough cards share a common game mechanic to make it a keyword. 

Unstable
A mutant with Unstable is stronger than average. However, it has an ability with a negative effect (like damaging your Psycore when played, self-inflicting damage…)
Ex : Robot, Steam Warlord

Dual Core
A mutant with Dual Core can both attack and use its Action Ability during the same turn. 
Ex : Android

Execution (new version)
Execution abilities now trigger whenever the mutant destroys another mutant.

Reaper
Reaper abilities trigger whenever another mutant dies (usually any mutant, but there can be exceptions).
Replaces some previous Execution abilities.
Ex : Cerberus, The Forgotten One

Ossuary
Ossuary abilities become active while you have at least 10 cards in your discard. 
Ex : Bushi, The Collector

The Equip former keyword disappears, to be replaced by 2 new keywords.

Equipped
Equipped abilities are active while the mutant has at least one Orb equipped. 
Replaces some Equip abilities. 
Ex : Barbarian

Unsheathe
Unsheathe abilities trigger whenever you attach an Orb to the mutant. 
Replaces some Equip abilities. 
Ex : Master Shinzo, El Gringo (new version)

Adapt (new version)
The former Adapt format changes to facilitate integration of mutants with Adapt abilities in multiple archetypes. 

The new keyword : Adapt - Mutants with Adapt abilities can gain EVO when specific conditions are met.

Former abilities with the Invasion keywords are modified :

Invasion (new version)
Invasion abilities now trigger whenever the mutant damages a building. 
Ex : Shell Shock, Marship Mallow

Demolition
Demolition abilities trigger whenever the mutant destroys a building.
Replaces some Invasion abilities
Ex : Planet Cleaner (new version)

Cityscape
Cityscape abilities are linked to the presence of non-Psycore buildings on the board. 
Replaces some Invasion abilities
Ex : Alien, Behemoth (new version)

Aura
Aura abilities grant bonuses or abilities to multiple mutants. 
Numerous mutants with Squad now have their Passive abilities become Auras.  

Status Condition
The bold gameplay term is added to encompass Burning, Stasis, ATK/HP decreases, and numerous other effects in the future. 

Cleanse

The gameplay term bold is added, and means “Remove all status conditions”. 

New cards
New cards added to the game. 

Building Cards

Planning Table
5 HP 
1 EVO
Passive - All your mutants with an active Tactics have +1ATK and +1HP. 

This card reinforces the Blades archetype around the cards with Tactics, which did not have a dedicated building.

Missile Turret
4 HP
1 EVO
Passive - At the end of your turn, this building deals 2 damage to the Primary Objective.

An aggressive card to put constant pressure on the opponent. Reminder: the Primary Objective is the Psycore or Boss, depending on the game mode.

Engineering Lab
5 HV
1 EVO
Passive - Whevener one of your mutants is healed by Autorepair, it obtains +1ATK.

This card brings a dedicated building around the cards with Autorepair.

Support cards

Battle Plan
For each mutant with an active Tactics on your board, draw a card.  

This card reinforces the Blades archetype around the cards with Tactics, which did not have a dedicated support card.

Strength in Numbers
Each mutant you control obtains +1ATK this turn. Each Summoned mutant obtains an additional +1ATK. 

We were missing cards to carry a mass attack, so we chose to make it a version that particularly strengthens decks based on filling the board with Summons.

Reconstruction
Discard a Building: Add a Building from your deck to your hand.  

A very efficient card that allows recycling a building during the game (such as an additional incubator). It also reinforces the theme of Buildings in the Space gene.

Savage Strike
Discard a card: Target a Zoo mutant you control which deals its ATK as damage to a random opposing entity. 

An aggressive card for Zoo mutants, also usable in PvE against a boss. It remains playable in all decks, if you have mutants with the Zoo gene on the battlefield.

Basic Troopers
Discard a Space mutant: Summon 2 Basic Troopers with Squad. 

A card that completes the Support card cycle with a discard cost of a certain gene, as well as fixing one of the problems identified around the Squad deck.

Modified/Replaced cards
Completely modified cards (major effect/concept change)

Mutant Cards
A large number of mutants without abilities or with only basic keywords have been modified to better fit with the different archetypes of the game.

Starters
 
Robot - Tech
ATK 2/3/4/5/7
HP 2/3/4/5/7

Autorepair 1/1/2/2/4
Unstable - When this mutant enters play, your Psycore takes 2 damage. 
The old Robot design did not allow us to have a sufficiently interesting card. Creating an ability with the new keyword Unstable allows us to have a starter with higher base stats, but with a drawback.

Warrior - Blades
ATK 1/2/3/4/6
HP  1/2/3/4/6

Tactics - While an opposing mutant is damaged, this mutant has +1/1/2/3/4 ATK.
The previous design of the Warrior wasn’t convincing enough for us with its actual form, we wanted to push more of the Tactics archetype through this starter.

Basic

ATK 1/3/5/7/9
HP 2/3/5/7/10

Armor 1/1/1/1/2
Guardian
Unstable - When this mutant attacks, it gets -2 ATK after the fight until the end of your opponent’s turn.

This mutant was lacking impact in his previous version. We gave it a place as a Basic Guardian in Tech and Mystic, while giving it the Unstable trait to have a more defensive mutant.

Evasion

ATK 1/2/3/5/8
HP 2/4/5/7/10

Guardian
Tactics - While you have another mutant without Guardian, this mutant has +1/2/3/4/5 ATK and Piercing.

We decided to reinforce this mutant’s theme by giving it a Tactics ability associated to it’s Guardian’s role. It gets stronger when it has a mutant to protect.

El Gringo - Blades
ATK 2/3/4/5/7
HP 2/3/4/5/7

Unsheathe - Whenever this mutant is equipped with an Orb, it deals 1/1/2/2/4 damage to the opposing mutant with the least HP.

El Gringo was too powerful and too redundant with the Barbarian starter. We thus decided to modify its ability to give it Unsheathe fitting more with its visual style.

ATK 1/3/4/6/9

Guardian

The fundamental mechanic of Captain Patriot still revolves around being a Guardian with Squad and Autorepair but now we tie it to the Squad ability making it more fitting in decks featuring multiple Squad mutants.

Advanced

Guardian

The previous ability of Cernunnos was too close to how Tactics work and was too close to Sir Puggington’s ability, this is why we decided to modify it to play more on the random aspect of the Zoo.
